meta_description: Hire elite nearshore Java engineers vetted by Axiom Cortex™ for enterprise-grade Spring Boot applications. Expertise in performance tuning and cloud-native architecture.
technical_analysis: Our vetting process for nearshore Java engineers involves a production-style incident. Candidates are given a Spring Boot application with excessive memory usage and slow startup times. They must use a profiler like YourKit or JProfiler to analyze a heap dump, identify the memory leak's source, and propose a fix. Success also requires optimizing for cloud-native performance; our nearshore Java engineers must recommend specific GC tuning parameters (e.g., G1GC) and strategize on creating a smaller, layered Docker image to reduce container size and achieve a p95 startup time of under 5 seconds. This practical challenge ensures that the nearshore Java engineers we provide are equipped to handle the demands of modern enterprise systems, focusing on reliability and efficiency.
intro: Java engineers from TeamStation AI deliver production-grade systems with cognitive calibration and measurable performance.
